claim.claim-text: a recurrent neural network arranged to receive at an input a time series of measurements indicative of energy usage or activity in the energy system derived from the real-time data from the end devices and to identify based on the input 1) a time or occupancy dependent mode of use of the energy system or 2) a high load, long duration event, indicative of use of a particular appliance, disaggregated from the measurements,
2. A system according to claim 1, wherein the mode of use is a seasonal or calendar related pattern, arrival, night-time slow-down, holiday.
3. A system according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the event represents an EV charging, operation of wet-goods appliance or heat-appliance or cooling appliance.
4. A system according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein dedicated neural networks are provided for a plurality of target appliances and/or modes.
5. A system according to any of claims 1 to 4, wherein a primary network dynamically branches to a further neural network arranged to:
create and re-inforce and train a network when measurement of a pattern is within range of an output threshold of a primary network, and then decide to:
undertake a 'forward-pass' classification in a series of adjacent networks or selectively learn and undertake a 'backwards-pass' update of weights within the network, when a network match is found.
6. A method of managing and optimising an energy system at a location or low voltage network by classification of events or behaviours observed in energy usage in the energy system, comprising:

at a software system, receiving at the input of a recurrent neural network a time series of measurements indicative of energy usage or activity in the energy system, wherein the energy system comprises distributed end devices and energy resources, wherein at least one resource is a rechargeable battery and the end devices provide real-time data on energy supply or usage of the energy resources across the energy system from which the measurements are derived, and wherein the neural network is arranged to identify based on the input 1) a time or occupancy dependent mode of use of the energy system or 2) a high load, long duration event, indicative of use of a particular appliance, disaggregated from the measurements,

7. A computer program for managing and optimising an energy system at a location or low voltage network by classification of events or behaviours observed in energy usage in an the energy system, wherein the energy system comprises distributed end devices and energy resources, wherein at least one resource is a rechargeable battery and the end devices provide real-time data on energy supply or usage of the energy resources across the energy system, the computer program when run on a computing device being arranged to carry out the steps:

receiving at the input of a recurrent neural network a time series of measurements indicative of energy usage or activity in the energy system derived from the real-time data, wherein the neural network is arranged to identify based on the input 1) a time or occupancy dependent mode of use of the energy system or 2) a high load, long duration event, indicative of use of a particular appliance, disaggregated from the measurements,
